Interpolates sea surface temperature data to coastal regions Resamples sst data to same extent, resolution and projection as aoi Interpolates from mean of adjacent sea cells

Source: R/workerfunctions.R
dot-sea_to_coast.Rd

Interpolates sea surface temperature data to coastal regions Resamples sst data to same extent, resolution and projection as aoi Interpolates from mean of adjacent sea cells

Usage

.sea_to_coast(sst.r, aoi.r, ext_cells = 8)

Arguments

sst.r

  • sea surface temperature data

aoi.r

  • dtm of area of interest where sea = NA

Value

sst spatrasters of same projection, res and extent as aoi with matching coastline

Examples

sst.r<-terra::rast(system.file("extdata/sst/NWSClim_NWSPPE_r001i1p00000_2018_gridT.nc",package="mesoclim"),"SST")[[1]]
#> Error: [rast] filename is empty. Provide a valid filename
aoi.r<-terra::unwrap(mesoclim::ukcpinput$dtm)
terra::plot(.sea_to_coast(sst.r,aoi.r))
#> Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)): error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'plot': error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'project': object 'sst.r' not found
